_warning: Pricing and feature facts here are ESTIMATES for template scaffolding. VERIFY every claim against the competitor's own site before publishing — inaccurate competitor pricing is a legal and credibility risk. Set verified=true only after you have a source.

subject.name: Sygnal
subject.one_liner: Real-time, individual-level buyer-intent signals scored against your ICP blueprint.
subject.pricing_note: $29/mo Pro, $99/mo Builder, $299/mo Scale; free trial, no credit card.
why_choose: Individual-level signals: the actual person asking, not a fuzzy account score
Under-48-hour freshness so the buying moment is still open
Scored against your ICP blueprint (semantics, intent, pain, competitor mentions)
Self-serve pricing a fraction of enterprise intent platforms

competitors.name: Bombora
competitors.one_liner: Company-level B2B intent signals built from topic-surge data.
competitors.pricing_note: Reported around $25,000/year; enterprise sales, no self-serve tier.
why_switch: Priced for enterprise budgets, not founders or small teams
Account-level intent, so you still have to find the person
Surge data can trail the actual buying moment by days
No self-serve path to start today
competitors.best_for: Large marketing teams buying broad account-level intent.

competitors.name: 6sense
competitors.one_liner: ABM platform layering intent, firmographics, and orchestration.
competitors.pricing_note: Reported around $62,000/year; annual contracts, enterprise onboarding.
why_switch: Sold as a platform with a platform price and setup
Optimized for account prioritization, not reaching the individual
Overkill if you need one fresh, actionable person today
Long contracts and procurement cycles
competitors.best_for: Enterprise ABM teams that need a full orchestration platform.

competitors.name: Demandbase
competitors.one_liner: Account-based marketing and intent platform for enterprise GTM.
why_switch: Enterprise-first packaging and pricing
Account-level signals rather than the individual in-market buyer
Heavy platform to adopt for a single motion
Freshness is secondary to coverage
competitors.best_for: Enterprise GTM teams running account-based programs.

competitors.name: ZoomInfo
competitors.one_liner: Large B2B contact database with intent and go-to-market data.
competitors.pricing_note: Enterprise contracts; frequently cited five- to six-figure annual deals.
why_switch: Priced and packaged for enterprise data teams
Intent is one layer inside a much larger contract
Account-level intent, not the individual asking for help
Seat-based pricing punishes lean teams
competitors.best_for: Sales orgs that need a broad B2B contact and data platform.

competitors.name: Clay
competitors.one_liner: Enrichment and outbound orchestration workbench (bring-your-own data).
competitors.level: account + individual (if you supply the signal)
competitors.pricing_note: Free tier plus usage-based credits; scales with enrichment volume.
why_switch: Clay enriches and orchestrates, but does not generate the intent signal itself
You still need a signal source to feed it
Credit costs compound as you add enrichment providers
Sygnal plugs into Clay via webhook to be that signal source
competitors.best_for: Teams that already have a signal and want to enrich and route it.

competitors.name: Apollo
competitors.one_liner: Contact database with sequencing and basic intent filters.
competitors.pricing_note: Self-serve tiers from roughly $49/user/month; enterprise above.
why_switch: Intent filters are broad and account-level
Contacts are matched from a database, not from an active public conversation
Great for lists, weaker for catching a live buying moment
No 48-hour public-pain window
competitors.best_for: Teams that want a large contact database plus sequencing in one place.

competitors.name: RB2B
competitors.one_liner: Person-level website visitor identification pushed to your tools.
why_switch: Only sees people who already visited YOUR site
Misses buyers researching the problem elsewhere (Reddit, G2, forums)
Works best alongside an off-site intent source
No buying-intent score against your ICP blueprint
competitors.best_for: Teams that want to identify the people already visiting their website.
